name: Fly.io Sprites
summary: Persistent, hardware-isolated Linux microVMs for running arbitrary code such as AI agents, with checkpoint/restore and per-second billing.
description: Sprites keep their ext4 filesystem between runs, go idle (`warm`/`cold`) with no compute charges, and wake on the next request. Fly.io lists AI code execution, untrusted code, development environments and CI tasks as use cases.
